claim: The repository is a single React/Vite calculator application with a browser-only runtime.
notes: The app shell is implemented entirely in the client and uses local storage for persistence.

claim: The shared evaluator module implements expression evaluation, formatting, unit conversion, and financial helpers.
notes: This file is the main cross-cutting dependency for several calculator modes.

claim: The app shell routes among standard, scientific, converter, financial, and grapher modes.
notes: Mode selection is implemented in the shared app shell and header navigation.

claim: Vitest and Testing Library cover app behavior, evaluator semantics, and build output.
notes: The tests are executed in jsdom and use a shared setup file.

claim: Observed commands pass or fail as recorded: npm test and npm run build succeeded, npm run lint reported existing issues.
notes: The test suite completed 31 passing tests and the build emitted dist assets.

claim: Themes are applied through CSS variables and a data-theme attribute on the document root.
notes: This is the mechanism behind the Windows 11 and other themes.

claim: The app supports history replay and keyboard shortcuts through dedicated modal and drawer components.
notes: These components are launched from the shared header controls.

claim: The app uses Web Audio for tactile feedback and does not depend on a backend audio service.
notes: Audio is disabled only when the UI sound setting is false.

claim: The current lint baseline is not clean and reports 20 issues across components and utilities.
notes: The output included unused imports and a React hooks set-state-in-effect warning.
